metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: plugins that draw bands and panes in the terminal and Claude Desktop.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt in the terminal and in Claude Desktop.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands, shows what they would hit, and waits for Run anyway or Cancel, in the terminal and in Claude Desktop.

plugins.name: heads-up
plugins.description: Watches the running session and shows a heads-up when something is off: failing tools or tests in a row, edits outside the project, a context spike, or a run that stalls.
